description: Deep Learning Super-Resolution & Sub-Pixel Mapping system for NTRO Satellite Imagery

components.name: Multi-Spectral Ingestion Engine
components.description: Loads GeoTIFF rasters (RGB + NIR), handles spatial projections (CRS), and generates 128x128 patches.

components.name: Super-Resolution Neural Network
components.description: 4x spatial upscaling neural network tailored for satellite multi-spectral bands with physics-guided preservation.

components.name: Sub-Pixel Mapper (SPM)
components.description: Allocates fractional land cover classes within mixed pixels to crisp high-resolution spatial boundaries.

components.name: Inference Web API
components.description: REST endpoints serving batch tile inference, geotiff export, and sub-pixel metrics.

components.name: Interactive Geospatial Workbench
components.description: Interactive web app for split-screen swipe comparison, zoom-level super-resolution rendering, and spectral analysis.
